name: spinach yogurt smoothie
instructions:
The green half of a matched pair with [[chocolate-oatmeal-smoothie]] — same four-slot structure, opposite pole on each slot (fruit for sweetness, dairy for fat, unflavored protein, leafy green for fiber).

FOUR-SLOT BUILD:
- FRUIT (sweetness) — APPLE, STRAWBERRY, and/or BANANA are the main fruits for the sweetness slot (1 apple cored and chopped, or equivalent).
- GREEK YOGURT (fat + creaminess) — ~1 cup. Not peanut butter.
- VANILLA PROTEIN POWDER (protein) — 1 scoop. Not chocolate.
- SPINACH (healthy fiber) — a big handful (~2 cups packed). Not oats.

AROMATIC SLOT — GINGER OR CILANTRO (NOT BOTH):
- Fresh ginger (thumb-tip knob) — warm/bright register; more familiar juice-bar direction
- OR fresh cilantro (small handful) — herbal/green-forward register; leans into the spinach
- Pick one — they don't stack.

OPTIONAL FRUIT ADD-INS: strawberries pair well with the apple and add color + brighter fruit flavor.

Blend in a vitamix or high-power blender until smooth. Add a splash of water or milk if it's not moving.
notes:
The green pole of a two-smoothie pair. See [[chocolate-oatmeal-smoothie]] for the parallel build — same four slots, opposite ingredient in each.

=== PARALLEL STRUCTURE (COMPARE TO CHOCOLATE OATMEAL) ===

| Slot | This (Spinach Apple) | [[chocolate-oatmeal-smoothie]] |
|---|---|---|
| Sweetener | apple / strawberry / banana | banana (OPTIONAL) |
| Fat + creaminess | greek yogurt | peanut butter |
| Protein powder | vanilla | chocolate |
| Healthy fiber | spinach | rolled oats |

The two smoothies are designed to sit in opposite registers — this one reads bright/fresh/green, the chocolate oatmeal reads rich/dessert-adjacent/comfort. Same purpose (protein + fiber + fat + sweetness in one drink), different flavor destinations.

=== GREEK YOGURT IS NECESSARY — MAKES IT CREAMY ===

Greek yogurt is what turns the smoothie from a frothy fibrous suspension into an actual creamy drink. Without it, the vitamix aerates the ingredients into a green pond-water texture — technically drinkable but not enjoyable. The greek yogurt's thickness anchors the texture. Not optional here (in the chocolate oatmeal counterpart, peanut butter plays this fat/body role instead).

PLAIN YOGURT (SECONDARY) — HAVEN'T TESTED IT: might work but I haven't tried it. Plain yogurt is thinner and higher-water than greek, so the concern is whether it can carry the texture load.

=== APPLE IS REQUIRED HERE (BUT BANANA IS OPTIONAL IN THE CHOCOLATE VERSION) ===

The parallel structure between this smoothie and [[chocolate-oatmeal-smoothie]] is asymmetric on the sweetener slot:

- SPINACH APPLE: greek yogurt and vanilla protein powder do NOT carry sweetness on their own — greek yogurt is tangy, vanilla protein is neutral. Something has to fill the sweetener slot or the drink reads flat/tangy/green. Apple is REQUIRED for that reason.
- CHOCOLATE OATMEAL: peanut butter and chocolate protein powder both carry INNATE SWEETNESS. That version's fat + protein slots are already doing double duty (fat + sweetness) — banana is optional there.

So the four-slot structure isn't perfectly symmetric. On the green side, the sweetener has real load-bearing work to do.

Apple over banana specifically: apple gives gentle sweetness and bulk without pushing the smoothie into dessert territory. Banana would be sweeter, creamier, and more dessert-adjacent — wrong direction for this fresh-green register (right for the chocolate-oatmeal version's dessert direction).

=== VANILLA PROTEIN OVER CHOCOLATE ===

Vanilla stays neutral and lets the spinach + apple + aromatic slot lead. Chocolate protein powder would compete with the green register and push the drink toward the chocolate-oatmeal-smoothie's territory — wrong direction for this build.

=== SPINACH OVER OATS — LEAFY-GREEN FIBER ===

Spinach is the healthy-fiber slot here. Blends smoothest and has the mildest flavor of the leafy greens; disappears into the drink texturally while contributing color, fiber, and micronutrients.

Other leafy greens work as swaps if you're out of spinach — mixed greens, arugula, kale (kale needs a longer blend to break down its fibrous stems). Not going in the primary ingredients here since this is specifically the spinach build.

=== AROMATIC SLOT — GINGER OR CILANTRO (NOT BOTH) ===

The smoothie wants a single aromatic to keep it from reading one-note-sweet. Mutually exclusive:
- GINGER: warm bite, pushes toward tropical / juice-bar register
- CILANTRO: herbal green-forward, leans into the spinach; pairs well with cucumber or lime if you happen to have them

Ginger + cilantro together is muddled and off. The chocolate oatmeal counterpart uses no aromatic — its flavor architecture is already carrying itself with the peanut butter + chocolate + banana.

=== SIBLING RECIPE ===

- [[chocolate-oatmeal-smoothie]]: the rich/comfort pole. Same four-slot structure, opposite ingredient in every slot.

=== COTTAGE CHEESE — CLASHING, TOO SALTY ===

Tried cottage cheese (because people make cheesecake with it) — it works TERRIBLY here: too salty. For something simple like this it doesn't work.

=== BLUEBERRIES — SECONDARY, NEED A FRIEND ===

Blueberries are secondary: their COLOR doesn't always play well with the greens, and they aren't as sweet as apple/banana/strawberry — so they need a friend (one of the sweeter fruits) to balance the yogurt/greens.

=== YOGURT — PLAIN AND GREEK BOTH PRIMARY, GREEK HAS A SLIGHT EDGE ===

Both plain and greek yogurt are primary here; I think GREEK has a slight edge (thicker body against the fruit and greens).

=== MIXED / SPRING GREENS — SECONDARY ===

Mixed greens / baby spring mix work as the green slot in a pinch — the color and flavor aren't as good as spinach, but it's fine.

=== SILKEN TOFU SUB — TESTED, FINE ===

Ran out of yogurt and substituted SILKEN TOFU — it was fine. AVOCADO would probably be fine too, but untested.

=== BANANA — SECONDARY (THE VANILLA PROTEIN POWDER CONFLICT) ===

Banana goes secondary for the sole reason that it doesn't work well with VANILLA PROTEIN POWDER — which apples and berries do. (Banana remains structural in [[cucumber-avocado-smoothie]], which has no protein powder — the conflict is specific to this build.)
